ADDED i1: Tests {@link SimpleBloomFilter#estimateIntersection(BloomFilter)}, which estimates the number of distinct items shared between two Bloom filters.

  • m = 72 bits
ADDED i3: Creates an empty {@link SimpleBloomFilter} using {@link #TEST_SHAPE}. @return a new empty filter.

ADDED i8: filterFrom1 and filterFrom1And11 share exactly the single "FROM1" item.
ADDED i9: filterFrom1's single item is also contained in the full filter.
ADDED i10: The full filter and filterFrom1And11 share both of the latter's items.
ADDED i11: Intersecting with an empty filter yields zero in both directions.
ADDED i12: Two disjoint filters covering the lower and upper halves of the bit range.
ADDED i13: Estimating the intersection of disjoint filters is not supported.
